Example data: Jurua River, Cruzeiro do Sul (Acre, Brazil)

Source: R/data.R
jurua_data.Rd

Example files installed with the package, used in the vignettes and examples. They cover a 2.5 x 2.5 km crop over a meander of the Jurua River, its floodplain and part of the town of Cruzeiro do Sul, in the state of Acre, Brazil (approximate center: 7.649 S, 72.654 W). They are not R objects: they are files, accessed with system.file().

Format

Four files in the package's extdata folder:

jurua_s2_20190816.tif, jurua_s2_20240814.tif

Crops of Sentinel-2 L2A (Collection 1) images from 2019-08-16 and 2024-08-14, both cloud-free over the crop. Seven bands at 10 m (B02, B03, B04, B05, B08, B11, B12; the 20 m bands were resampled with nearest neighbor), in UTM zone 18S (EPSG:32718). Original integer values from the provider: reflectance = (value - 1000) / 10000.

jurua_dem_copernicus.tif

Copernicus GLO-30 digital elevation model, reprojected to UTM zone 18S at 30 m. Elevation in meters.

jurua_plots.csv

25 fictitious plots, randomly placed inside the crop, with the columns plot, longitude and latitude (decimal degrees, WGS 84). For demonstration only.

Source

Earth Search (Element 84, AWS Open Data), collections sentinel-2-c1-l2a and cop-dem-glo-30, accessed in October 2026. Sentinel-2 data: Copernicus/ESA. DEM: Copernicus DEM, (c) DLR and Airbus. The script that produced the files is data-raw/jurua.R in the package repository.

Examples

folder <- system.file("extdata", package = "rsguide")
list.files(folder)
#> [1] "jurua_dem_copernicus.tif" "jurua_plots.csv"         
#> [3] "jurua_s2_20190816.tif"    "jurua_s2_20240814.tif"   

img <- terra::rast(file.path(folder, "jurua_s2_20240814.tif"))
terra::plotRGB((img - 1000) / 10000, r = "B04", g = "B03", b = "B02", stretch = "lin")
